brand.name: BCN Account
brand.tagline: One account. The entire BCN ecosystem.

authShell.heroSubtitle: Sign in once to access quiz, profile, membership, and every BCN app.
authShell.f2Body: Link Google, GitHub, and Discord to a single account.
authShell.f3Body: Verify community membership and app access.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in with your BCN account.
login.oauthSubtitle: Sign in with your BCN account to open {app}. You’ll return to the app afterward.
login.oauthBanner: You’re opening {app} — sign in here, then you’ll go back to the app.
login.socialUnavailable: {provider} isn’t available yet. Please sign in with email and password.
login.socialNotLinked: {provider} isn’t linked yet. Sign in with email first, then connect it under Connections.
login.oauthFailed: Provider sign-in failed. Please try again.
login.oauthBlocked: Your BCN account is not active.
login.oauthNeeds2fa: Provider sign-in succeeded. Enter your 2FA code to finish.
login.oauthNeeds2faSetup: Provider sign-in succeeded. Set up 2FA to finish.
login.setupPasswordHint: Confirm your account password to start 2FA setup.
login.sessionFailed: Signed in, but the session cookie wasn’t kept. Open http://localhost:5173 (not 127.0.0.1).

register.title: Create account
register.subtitle: Register a new BCN account.
register.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in

password.forgotBody: Enter your email to receive a reset OTP.

recovery.title: 2FA recovery
recovery.subtitle: Lost authenticator access? Verify email to disable 2FA.
recovery.otpSent: Recovery code sent (if the account is valid).
recovery.resetOk: 2FA reset. Sign in again to set it up.

welcome.guided: A short guided setup — like opening the box for the first time
welcome.intro: One account for the entire BCN ecosystem. We’ll walk you through a few short steps.
welcome.point2: Optionally link Google / GitHub for faster sign-in later
welcome.point3: Enter Account Center and use BCN apps
welcome.discordBody: Discord is required to verify BCN membership. Join the BCN server before connecting.
welcome.discordRequired: Discord + a valid membership are required to continue.
welcome.optionalBody: Link them now, or skip and do it later under Connections.
welcome.readyBody: Your Account Center is ready. Welcome to the BCN ecosystem.
welcome.oauthCancelled: You cancelled connecting {provider}. You can try again anytime.
welcome.oauthAlreadyLinked: This {provider} account is linked to another BCN account. Disconnect it from the previous account, then try again.

overview.title: Account overview
overview.ready: Your BCN identity is ready across the ecosystem.
overview.appRolesHint: Your current roles on each app (MEMBER, MENTOR, ADMIN…).

account.title: Profile
account.avatarInvalidType: Only image files are allowed (JPEG, PNG, WebP…).
account.avatarTooLarge: Image must be {maxMb} MB or smaller.
account.emailOtpSent: OTP sent to the new email.
account.bioPlaceholder: Share a short introduction and your journey at BCN…
account.profile3dHint: Preview it here. The same artifact appears on the right of your public profile.

publicProfile.bioFallback: This member has not added an introduction yet.
publicProfile.artifactHint: Drag to rotate or use the controls below.
publicProfile.achievementsHint: A milestone activates when the system records the related activity.
publicProfile.timelineHint: Recent milestones recorded by BCN or an application in the ecosystem.
publicProfile.notFoundDescription: This profile does not exist or the member is not currently active.

connections.title: Connected accounts
connections.subtitle: Link Google, GitHub, Discord, or Zalo for sign-in and membership checks.
connections.disconnectConfirm: You will not be able to sign in or verify membership with this account until it is connected again.

membership.title: Membership
membership.subtitle: You need at least one trusted BCN group membership.

applications.title: Applications
applications.subtitle: BCN apps linked to your account and the roles you hold.
applications.emptyHint: An admin must grant you access before apps appear here.
applications.activeHint: You can sign in to this app via BCN SSO.
applications.blockedHint: Access is blocked. Contact an admin if this is unexpected.

oauthError.hint: Ask a BCN admin if you need access to this application.

APP_ACCESS_DENIED.title: Access not granted
APP_ACCESS_DENIED.body: Your account does not have access to {app}. An admin must grant ACTIVE access before you can sign in.

APP_DISABLED.title: Application disabled
APP_DISABLED.body: {app} is not accepting sign-in right now.

STEP_UP_AUTH_REQUIRED.title: 2FA required
STEP_UP_AUTH_REQUIRED.body: {app} requires two-factor authentication. Turn on 2FA, then try again.

ACCOUNT_BLOCKED.title: Account is not active
ACCOUNT_BLOCKED.body: Your BCN account is not ACTIVE, so {app} cannot be opened.

MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED.title: BCN membership not verified
MEMBERSHIP_REQUIRED.body: App access alone is not enough. Link Discord (or Zalo) and verify membership before opening {app}.

OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI_INVALID.title: Invalid redirect URI
OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI_INVALID.body: The callback URL for {app} is not registered on Profiles.

OAUTH_ERROR.title: Could not sign in to the app
OAUTH_ERROR.body: BCN SSO did not complete for {app}. Try again or contact an admin.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Your BCN-verified learning and community journey.
timeline.officialHint: This timeline is read-only. Milestones are recorded by the BCN system or an administrator to keep the information trustworthy.
timeline.adminHint: Record verified milestones for this user. The user can view them but cannot make changes.
timeline.deleteConfirm: “{title}” will be removed from the official timeline. This action cannot be undone.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Manage active SSO and application sessions.
sessions.revokeConfirm: The {app} session will be signed out immediately and must authenticate again to continue.
sessions.revokeOthersConfirm: Every other sign-in session will be revoked. Your current session will remain active.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage the extra protection and recovery options for your BCN account.
security.enabledDescription: Your account requires a verification code when signing in.
security.disabledDescription: Add another verification step to better protect your account.
security.enableDescription: Confirm your password to get a QR code and connect your authenticator app.
security.backupStatusUnknown: The remaining backup code count is unavailable.
security.backupDescription: Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe.
security.backupOnce: These codes are shown only during this setup. You cannot download them again after leaving the page.
security.backupFileWarning: Keep this file somewhere safe. Each code can only be used once.
security.scanDescription: Open your authenticator app, scan the QR code, then enter the 6-digit code to finish.
security.qrAlt: QR code for two-factor authentication setup
security.requiredDescription: An administrator requires 2FA for this account, so it cannot be disabled.
security.dangerDescription: This removes the authenticator and all current backup codes from your account.
security.recoveryDescription: Use the recovery flow if you lose access to your authenticator device.
security.downloadHint: For security, existing backup codes cannot be read again. The download button appears only immediately after new codes are created.

admin.deleteConfirm: The account and related access data will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

rbac.title: Application access control
rbac.subtitle: Manage access per application, from roles and permissions to individual users.
rbac.managerModeHint: You can grant access and assign user roles. Only platform admins can change application settings, roles, permissions, and managers.
rbac.createHint: Code and client ID should match what your app uses in OAuth.
rbac.loadError: Could not load access control data.
rbac.name: Name
rbac.clientSecretHint: The application backend uses these keys to record official timeline events. The secret is shown once.
rbac.clientSecretReady: Copy this secret now. It will not be shown again.
rbac.keysHint: Issue multiple keys and disable a leaked one without turning the application off.
rbac.disableKeyConfirm: This key will stop authenticating immediately. Other keys and the application stay active.
rbac.accessModeMembers: Open to all eligible BCN members (block individuals only)
rbac.disableConfirm: New sign-ins will be blocked and all active application sessions will be revoked immediately.
rbac.decisionFlowHint: A user only receives permissions after passing all four checks in order.
rbac.flowIdentityHint: The user account is not blocked.
rbac.flowMembershipHint: The user belongs to a trusted BCN group.
rbac.flowAccessHint: The application access record is ACTIVE.
rbac.flowPermissionHint: Permissions are combined from every assigned role.
rbac.uriHint: Only listed redirect URIs can complete the OAuth authorize flow.
rbac.noRolesYet: Create a role to start assigning permissions.
rbac.noPermsYet: No permissions yet. Add the first permission.
rbac.pickRoleFirst: Select a role on the left to toggle its permissions.
rbac.accessHint: Pick permissions by name; the technical code is for APIs only.
rbac.deleteRoleConfirm: This role will be removed from every user. This action cannot be undone.
rbac.deletePermissionConfirm: This permission will be removed from every role. This action cannot be undone.
rbac.removeUriConfirm: The application will no longer be able to redirect to {uri} after removal.
rbac.usersHint: Grant application access first, then assign roles to determine effective permissions.
rbac.noUsers: No users have access to this app yet.
rbac.grantAccessHint: Search by name or email, pick a user, then grant access. Granting access does not assign a role automatically.
rbac.blockAccessConfirm: This user's active sessions for the application will be revoked immediately.
rbac.managersHint: Managers can only administer assigned applications; search by name to add one.
rbac.removeManagerConfirm: This user will no longer be able to manage application settings or members.
rbac.manifestHint: Paste bcn-app.yml. Removed roles and permissions are deprecated instead of immediately deleted.
